answer_1.quote: We propose WaveFM, a high-fidelity vocoder for speech synthesis conditioned on mel-spectrograms.

answer_2.quote: Additionally, we incorporate objective automatic metrics to assess sample quality, including Multi-resolution STFT (M-STFT) loss, Perceptual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ), Mel-cepstral distortion (MCD) with dynamic time warping, Periodicity error, and the F1 score for voiced/unvoiced (V/UV) classification.

answer_4.quote: Given the need to evaluate performance on out-of-distribution data, we conduct a 5-point Similarity Mean Opinion Score (SMOS) test as described in BigVGAN. This subjective evaluation is carried out by ten volunteers, and the reported SMOS scores include a 95% confidence interval.
answer_4.guideline: The 5-point Similarity Mean Opinion Score (SMOS) test is used to evaluate the similarity of generated audio to real audio.
